final_answer:
The most recent paper in arXiv's Algebraic Topology (math.AT) listing is arXiv:2611.08406. It was submitted on 5 Nov 2026 and has the highest ID among the five new math.AT submissions in the 6 Nov 2026 listing. Its primary subject is Mathematics > Algebraic Topology.

**Title:** Exotic smooth structures on complex projective spaces

**Authors:** Yueshi Hou, Hana Jia Kong, Zhouli Xu

**Abstract:** We study smooth structures on the topological manifold underlying complex projective space. We conjecture that every complex projective space ℂℙn with n>3 admits an exotic smooth structure. We prove two results providing strong evidence for this conjecture. First, the set of complex dimensions n for which ℂℙn admits an exotic smooth structure has natural density one. Second, we explicitly identify 266 congruence classes modulo 288 such that ℂℙn admits an exotic smooth structure whenever n>3 lies in one of these classes. These classes cover more than 92% of complex dimensions, improving the previously known lower bound of approximately 36%. We prove these results by first relating the concordance group of ℂℙn to suitable Atiyah–Hirzebruch filtration subgroups of its stable cohomotopy group, and then applying computations in chromatic homotopy theory at height 2.
